translation: Administer Renshen Zijin Dan (Ginseng Purple-Gold Pill, 人參紫金丹) internally, iron on Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散) externally, and then apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏); the condition may then be cured. <ins>Renshen Zijin</ins> <ins>Dingtong San</ins> (both seen in the injury of the shanjiao bone) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (seen in the injury of the vertex).
